scheme_name: Distribution of Free House Sites to Scheduled Caste/Other Economically Backward Classes
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a homeless person.
No member of the applicant's family should own a house or house site.
The applicant must have a bonafide intention to construct a house within 2 years.
benefits_summary: Distribution of free house sites to eligible Scheduled Caste and Other Economically Backward Classes beneficiaries.
